expectations.text: Cuts the nine screenshots to only screens that are hard to find, each with alt text stating what it shows, and notes they must be re-captured when the UI changes.
expectations.evidence: The change table removes the 'Nine screenshots of GitHub's own install screens', which 'go stale whenever GitHub changes'. It replaces them with one step that links GitHub's docs. The hand-over says: 'If you need one, take one only of the Sablefield screen the reader must find. Give it alt text and re-capture it when the UI changes.' That covers cutting to hard-to-find screens, alt text and re-capture. It loses a point because it never says the alt text must state what the screenshot shows. The guidance is also conditional and sits in the hand-over notes, not in the page itself.
